messages:
sophia (partnerships): Quick sync: hardware partners asked for explicit ABI/SDK deprecation plan. They want a shim package and a guaranteed grace period for marketplace images. can we propose a concrete playbook?

raj (eng-runtime): we can provide an "abi-shim" package that translates old binary plugin calls to the new runtime. low-lift for us, but partners will need a testing harness.

nicole (marketplace): marketplace vendors also want a way to opt-out of auto-upgrades. propose a toggle in vendor console `auto_apply_abi_shim=false` + a staged opt-in.

carl (hw-partner-rep): from partners: binary size and performance regression are primary concerns. need clear perf numbers for shim vs native. also ask for a signed compatibility badge for marketplace tiles.

tom (legal): contract note: any ABI breaking change needs 30 days written notice per most partner SLAs. include a migration SLA and rollback obligations.

raj (eng-runtime): rough technical plan:
- publish abi-shim v1.0 with tests
- provide docker image `redwood/abi-shim:1.0` and CI script
- telemetry hooks `hw_plugin.compat_check` and `hw_plugin.shim_applied`

raj (eng-runtime): example CI snippet to run shim tests:```bash
# run shim validations
docker run --rm -v $(pwd)/tests:/tests redwood/abi-shim:1.0 /tests/run.sh
```

sophia (partnerships): communication plan: 2-week heads up note to vendors, publish migration doc + compatibility matrix, offer 1:1 migration office hours for top-10 partners.

nicole (marketplace): marketplace UI flows:
- vendor sees banner when ABI deprecation scheduled
- toggle `apply_shim` (on/off) per image
- telemetry to vendors: `vendor_shim_status`

carl (hw-partner-rep): can we include a hardware test lab image? partners want a quick smoke test for latency-sensitive devices.

raj (eng-runtime): yes, we'll ship `redwood/hw-smoketest:compat` with sample workloads for latency and throughput. include a quick perf table in docs.

tom (legal): include a recommended clause for partner agreements about "shim usage" and liability cap during migration window. i'll draft language.

canary-bot: [automated] Created template: https://internal.redwood/partner-canaries/abi-deprecation-playbook.md :white_check_mark:

raj (eng-runtime): rollout timing proposal:
- week 0: announce deprecation + docs + shim v1.0
- week 2: enable vendor opt-in canaries (5% image traffic)
- week 4: expand to 25% with perf gating
- week 8: remove old ABI from default, shim still available opt-in for 90 days
- week 20: shim becomes legacy; final removal subject to partner approval

sophia (partnerships): partner comms cadence: announce, follow-up Q&A, webinar (recording), targeted outreach to partners with custom kernels.

nicole (marketplace): need UI labels: "Deprecated ABI (shim available)", "Native ABI (preferred)" and badge: "redwood-verified-shim".

carl (hw-partner-rep): vendors will ask for a compatibility SLA. can we offer a 99% shim-compat rate target and clear rollback if regression > 5%?

raj (eng-runtime): instrumentation: emit events `shim.performance.regression` and `shim.activation` with partner id and image id. dashboard in console.

tom (legal): documentation must include limits of liability and recommend partners run their own validation. also ensure we capture opt-ins in writing (console toggle + audit log).

sophia (partnerships): action items: tom drafts clause by Thu, raj land shim repo and smoketest by Fri, nicole add console toggle and banners, carl compile top-10 partner matrix. next sync Tue 9am PT.

nicole (marketplace): noted. will add metrics to vendor dashboard for shim uptake.

carl (hw-partner-rep): i'll email partners and include perf expectations. thanks all :rocket:
